headline: SMASH TV completes the gun ladder
lede: The cabinet handed out eight guns; this arena had six. Now the two signatures it was missing — the guided missile and the fire — are in.

notes.text: PR #2037 merged HEAT-SEEKER and FLAMER into SMASH TV (#2032): new WEAPONS rows, bonus-room drops, art, HUD icons, sounds and visuals across every layer.

HEAT-SEEKER fires one missile per shot, locked on the nearest heat at launch, curving at a bounded turn rate at constant speed — a clean sidestep still beats it — with a 10 px warhead splash and a 150-tick fizzle so it stays ammunition, not a cruise missile.
FLAMER breathes a three-pellet pierce fan with a hard ~45 px reach cap: king at contact range, useless across the stage.

The specials hide in the bonus rounds (room 4 / room 7) so the combat-room ladder stays byte-identical: all 9 pilot seeds still win, seed 1 deathless, co-op 9/9. smashcheck PASS 683 with 24 new pins and all 25 mutants dead; the autopilot carries a seat-law that walks around a dropped flame barrel — the law lives in the brain, so a human thumb gets the gun free.
